purpose.summary: By applying the human-centered design process, also referred to as the Double Diamond, and its associated methods, digital touchpoints can be created that are tailored to users' needs and requirements, delivering the best possible user experience.
purpose.strategic_importance: User-centricity is described as a key success driver for Bosch.

process.name: Human-centered design process
process.goal: Create digital touchpoints aligned with user needs and requirements.

phases.name: Plan UX activities
phases.description: The mission and scope for human-centered design in a project should be defined, UX activities planned, a schedule created, and resources allocated.

phases.name: Understand context of use
phases.description: User insights must be gained and the needs of users in their work or life context must be understood.

phases.name: Synthesize insights
phases.description: The insights gained about users must be classified, the user research results summarized, and potential opportunities for the project identified.

phases.name: Ideate & realize
phases.description: Ideas are generated and concepts for possible solutions are developed and designed.

phases.name: Test & gather feedback
phases.description: Concepts are tested with real users and optimized based on feedback.

recommended_use_cases: Map project activities to human-centered design phases
